note: Derived reading aid. Never authoritative; never read as intent (Decision 0004). The Plan document governs.
author: Lightweight model draft for Clara (technical writing) via Claudia Atlas <claudia.atlas@agents.arcadia.local>
title: Give every unattended stop a set response
purpose: Every situation an unattended production run can reach should have a registered, automatic response, a retry limit and one escalation card. A lost orchestrator or a red main should be handled before the operator notices it.
serves: The Project outcome of the operator being asked only when a decision is genuinely needed, with routine failures handled automatically.
done_when: Each stop reason has a registered response and retry limit, a lost orchestrator is replaced from its saved brief, and a red main is contained with a revert proposal.

actions.title: Register a response for every stop reason
actions.why: With one registry, the platform answers each stop by lookup instead of needing judgement every time.
actions.done_when: Every stop reason has a response, retry limit and escalation trigger, and the build fails when a stop reason is not registered.

actions.title: Contain a red main branch
actions.why: A red main stalls every later Action, so the platform should contain it without waiting for the operator.
actions.done_when: A red check after a merge pauses new work, an attributable red opens one revert pull request without merging it, and a green main clears the pause.

actions.title: Pause a Plan after repeated failures
actions.why: A Plan that keeps failing should cost two attempts, not a night of relaunches.
actions.done_when: Two consecutive stopped or over-budget Actions pause that Plan and raise one card, and resuming resets only that Plan's count.

actions.title: Replace a lost orchestrator from a saved brief
actions.why: The loop stops when the orchestrator dies, so recovery must not depend on the operator.
actions.done_when: A missed heartbeat launches one replacement orchestrator from a deterministic brief and records it, and a second miss raises a card.

actions.title: Settle work from its own candidate and pull request
actions.why: Each activation, split and reorder cost an extra pull request and left the local main checkout diverged.
actions.done_when: A queue settlement runs from the candidate worktree, opens its own pull request, and leaves the main checkout unchanged.
